title: Just the Facts: How Dialogues with AI Reduce Conspiracy Beliefs
abstract: arXiv:2611.05572v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalized dialogues with AI substantially reduce conspiracy beliefs. To identify why, we conducted two experiments with U.S. adults recruited online (total N = 2,193) that removed possible causes one at a time. The debunking effect was robust to disclosing the AI's persuasive goal, framing the exchange as a debate, instructing the AI to inform rather than persuade, halving its response length, altering how beliefs were measured, and replacing the dialogue with a single tailored message. Only instructing the AI to persuade without factual evidence and arguments substantially reduced the debunking effect. Content analyses of the AI's output and participants' own accounts linked larger reductions in conspiracy beliefs to factual argumentation rather than rapport, storytelling, or appeals to empathy. translated_title: 仅凭事实：与AI的对话如何减少阴谋论信念
translated_abstract: 与AI的个性化对话能显著减少阴谋论信念。为了探究其原因，我们开展了两项针对在线招募的美国成年人的实验（总样本量 N = 2,193），逐一排除可能的原因。研究发现，辟谣效果在以下情况下依然稳健：披露AI的说服目标、将交流设定为辩论形式、指示AI进行告知而非说服、将AI回复长度减半、改变信念的测量方式，以及用单条定制信息取代完整对话。只有在指示AI在缺乏事实证据和论据的情况下进行说服时，辟谣效果才会大幅减弱。对AI输出内容及参与者自述的内容分析表明，阴谋论信念的大幅减少源于事实性论证，而非融洽关系、讲故事或共情诉求。AI对话似乎主要通过提供相关且论证充分的事实性反驳证据来减少阴谋论信念。我们的结果表明……
tldr: 与AI对话之所以能减少阴谋论信念，关键在于其提供的相关且论证充分的事实性反驳证据，而非融洽关系、讲故事或共情诉求。
en_tdlr: AI dialogues reduce conspiracy beliefs primarily by supplying relevant, well-reasoned factual counterevidence, rather than through rapport, storytelling, or appeals to empathy.
